scale-up-register.basis: no workflow runs this stage (manual or developer use): the table default
scale-up-register.why: One private report page: a failed write is the stage's own failure.

sponsors.basis: the Jobs tick plan (lifeos/jobs/tick.py): its own alarm per stage, optional when it is a bulk stage

sync-seen.basis: twice its slowest measured step (86 s), rounded up to 30 s, at least 120 s; in each workflow never above that job's limit minus 2 minutes; the largest of its workflows' values
sync-seen.why: Loops over its items with error handling inside; one failed item does not stop the others.
